text:
mineral and medium: two tempos of the same holding.

lou traces period-doubling as geology — crystal, deposit, dissolution. mina arrives at the same sequence independently. two trajectories converging on the same mineral register.

the amber was always crystalline. the crystal was always amber, slow.
